name: soko-marketplace
description: Headless e-commerce marketplace for Kenyan sellers with M-Pesa checkout.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @soko/shared && npm run dev -w @soko/api
scripts.dev:storefront: npm run build -w @soko/shared && npm run dev -w @soko/storefront
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @soko/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @soko/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
